::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2010 in Bengaluru by Himamshu Khasnis. In February 2019 it unveiled the SCBM34xx/SCRF34xx family of LTE baseband and RF transceiver chips, which the company described as India's first indigenous 4G/5G modem chips. No public product news in 2025–26.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Baseband and RF transceiver chips for 4G LTE and 5G NR small cells, base stations and CPE; its product page also lists a NavIC receiver and a RISC-V microcontroller.
